segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Provides community banking, deposit, and lending services to consumers and small businesses in the Tampa Bay/Sarasota region.
segments.evidence: All of the Company's financial results are similar and considered by management to be aggregated into one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Bank through deposit accounts, interest on loans, and fees for banking services such as treasury management and merchant processing.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's revenue is primarily derived from the business of banking.
